text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — prefilling OOM on gpu-node-17 (redwood-inference/serving-runtime). Severity: P1.

alice_oncall: I'm on it, looking at node-17 logs now.

bob_sre: seeing repeated container restarts on node-17, OOM during prefill for long-context jobs (~300k tokens).

carla_ml: which model and quantization? could be kv-cache growth + long prompt.

alice_oncall: model: gptx-13b-q4, quant: q4_0, client request id sample: 0a9f3c. Prefill spike started ~1766543180.

bob_sre: paste of dmesg excerpt:
```
[  +0.000000] Out of memory: Killed process 23456 (containerd-shim) total-vm:xxxxxK, anon-rss:yyyyyK, file-rss:zzzK
[  +0.000001] oom_reaper: reaped process 23456
```

alice_oncall: rolling the instance out of rotation and draining. will cordon node-17.

bob_sre: doing `kubectl drain node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` now. moving pods to hotpool.

carla_ml: quick mitigation: enable prefix trimming for very long prompts and cap prefill length to 64k tokens for this model on that fleet. Can we push a runtime flag?

alice_oncall: we can patch runtime config: `/etc/redwood/runtime/overrides.yaml` with `prefill_max_tokens: 65536` and `kv_cache_limit: 12GB` — staging patch tested.

bob_sre: applied patch to affected pool, restarting serving-processes gracefully. will monitor.

incident-bot: Deploy (runtime-config-update) started by alice_oncall — build 2026.03.17-rc2.

dave_cs: any customer impact? seeing increased 500s from a small subset of customers. Not yet page from CS but one enterprise reported streaming drop.

erin_prod: quick telemetry check — errors spiked at 1766543190 and peaked for ~3m. Approx 0.4% of requests for the EU-hosted cluster failed with 502/503. Impacted customers: cust-omega (partial), cust-sierra (small).

alice_oncall: sending proactive note to CS to notify impacted customers and offer fallout details.

dave_cs: ACK — will send short message: "We’re seeing transient errors for long-context requests; mitigation in progress; ETA ~10-15m. Will follow up with postmortem."

carla_ml: also recommend adding a model-side early abort: if prefill tokens > 80k, return 413 or fallback to truncation. I'll file an eval rule.

bob_sre: monitoring: memory usage on remaining nodes decreased after patch. no further OOMs observed in last 3 minutes.

alice_oncall: keeping node-17 cordoned for now until we validate garbage collection heuristics.

incident-bot: incident status changed to mitigated by alice_oncall — reason: runtime limits applied, nodes drained.

erin_prod: creating incident summary for Slack channel and product analytics: short note with timeline + cust impact counts.

dave_cs: sent customer notes to cust-omega and cust-sierra, invited them to a follow-up.

carla_ml: follow-ups: add automated prefill-length histogram alert, add kv-cache eviction telemetry, and propose a default prefill hard-limit per model family.

alice_oncall: oncall handoff: @bob_sre will take overnight watch. I'll document steps in the runbook and update the incident ticket.

bob_sre: taking handoff — I'll keep watch and run soak tests for q4 quantized model on long-context workloads.

incident-bot: Pager closed at 1766543530.

alice_oncall: quick checklist to include in postmortem: root cause hypothesis (long-context prefill growth + insufficient kv-cache cap), immediate mitigation (runtime prefill cap, node drain), customer impact (0.4% error spike, 2 named customers notified), follow-ups (alerts, early-abort, eviction telemetry, config defaults).

dave_cs: thanks team.

carla_ml: filing follow-up PRs for runtime + model policy.

bob_sre: adding note to k8s autoscaler: prefer evict-to-coldmodel before killing processes.

alice_oncall: closing thread, will add final incident doc in #postmortems tomorrow. :white_check_mark:\"
